svg.aria-label: Five small repeated chores, each drawn as a stack of the same card copied three times: an SSH command, five dashboards after a deploy, credentials from a Slack thread, a PR description, a bug investigation. Each stack passes through the sentence I'm not doing this again and comes out as one thing: a shell function, a health check script, config, an agent, a workflow.
svg.text: the same chore, a third time, comes out the other side as something that runs
